setup: Chromium (Claude desktop browser pane) in mobile emulation 375x812, page served from localhost through the logging proxy traffic_proxy.py in front of RankService; same web build as the paper (build_web.py, Oxigraph 0.5.13).
session: 6 cities x 3 positions x 3 clocks x 2 orders = 108 context changes; Map tab and Check tab (server ranking, tampered copy, fare on phone) once per city.

third_party_requests.note: map framed by the offers' pickup points (map.fitBounds over offers), not by the passenger

offline: service stopped after the session; 3 further context changes re-ranked on the phone with remarks ('Ranked on this phone in 3 ms') with no connection
out_of_scope_by_design: Speed tab sends the benchmark searches' simulated contexts to time the same work on the server
Record-a-real-trip tab uploads the trip's GNSS fixes for the GNSS experiment
wording: In the observed sessions, no request contained the device position, clock or context.
